question.:question/problem:
Consider the following system of equations.

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}-x+2y &=6 \\ 2x-3y &=13 \\ 5x-y &=45\end{aligned}\right.
$$

Which of the following statements are true?

Select all that apply.
question.:question/worked-solution:
To classify the system, we first need to find its solution. The augmented matrix for this system is

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}-1 & 2 & 6 \\ 2 & -3 & 13 \\ 5 & -1 & 45\end{array}\right].
$$

Using the method of Gaussian elimination, we can reduce this matrix to row echelon form as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}-1 & 2 & 6 \\ 2 & -3 & 13 \\ 5 & -1 & 45\end{array}\right] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+2{R}_{1} \\  & ∼\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}-1 & 2 & 6 \\ 0 & 1 & 25 \\ 5 & -1 & 45\end{array}\right] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+5{R}_{1} \\  & ∼\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}-1 & 2 & 6 \\ 0 & 1 & 25 \\ 0 & 9 & 75\end{array}\right] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-9){R}_{2} \\  & ∼\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}-1 & 2 & 6 \\ 0 & 1 & 25 \\ 0 & 0 & -150\end{array}\right]\end{aligned}
$$

The final row corresponds to the equation $0x+0y=-150,$ and this has no solution. Therefore, our system has no solution, and we conclude that the system is inconsistent.

As a result, only statement “The system is inconsistent” is true.

question.:question/problem:
Consider the following system of equations

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}2x+3y &=-1 \\ x-2y &=1 \\ -x-5y &=2.\end{aligned}\right.
$$

Which of the following statements are true?

Select all that apply.
question.:question/worked-solution:
To classify the system, we first try to find its solution. The augmented matrix for this system is 

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}2 & 3 & -1 \\ 1 & -2 & 1 \\ -1 & -5 & 2\end{array}\right].
$$

Using the method of Gaussian elimination, we can reduce this matrix to row echelon form as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}2 & 3 & -1 \\ 1 & -2 & 1 \\ -1 & -5 & 2\end{array}\right] & {R}_{1} & ↔{R}_{2} \\  & ∼\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}1 & -2 & 1 \\ 2 & 3 & -1 \\ -1 & -5 & 2\end{array}\right] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+(-2){R}_{1} \\  & ∼\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}1 & -2 & 1 \\ 0 & 7 & -3 \\ -1 & -5 & 2\end{array}\right] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+{R}_{1} \\  & ∼\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}1 & -2 & 1 \\ 0 & 7 & -3 \\ 0 & -7 & 3\end{array}\right] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+{R}_{2} \\  & ∼\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}1 & -2 & 1 \\ 0 & 7 & -3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{array}\right]\end{aligned}
$$

 

Since any numbers $x$ and $y$ are solutions to the third equation $0x+0y=0$, we can remove this equation from the system. So, the corresponding system is now

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x-2y &=1 \\ 7y &=-3.\end{aligned}\right.
$$

From the second equation, we get $y=-\frac{3}{7}.$ Substituting this into the first equation, we get

$$
x-2\left(-\frac{3}{7}\right)=1\,⟹\,x=\frac{1}{7}.
$$

 
So, we conclude that the system is consistent independent. 

As a result, only statement “The system is consistent independent” is true.

$$

question.:question/problem:
Consider the following system of equations.

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}3x+2y &=-3 \\ -6x-4y &=6,\end{aligned}\right.
$$

which of the following statements are true?

I. The system is consistent independent

II. The system is consistent dependent

III. The system has no solution
question.:question/worked-solution:
To classify the system, we first need to find the solution to the system. The augmented matrix for this system is

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}3 & 2 & -3 \\ -6 & -4 & 6\end{array}\right].
$$

Using the method of Gaussian elimination, we can reduce this matrix to row echelon form as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}3 & 2 & -3 \\ -6 & -4 & 6\end{array}\right] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+2{R}_{1} \\  & ∼\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}3 & 2 & -3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{array}\right]\end{aligned}
$$

The system is now

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}3x+2y &=-3 \\ 0x+0y &=0.\end{aligned}\right.
$$

Since any numbers $x$ and $y$ form a solution of the final equation $0x+0y=0,$ we can remove this equation from the system. So, our system now consists of just a single equation:

$$
3x+2y=-3
$$

The basic variable is $x,$ and we have a free variable $y.$ That means we need to find $x$ in terms of $y.$ 

Therefore, since there are infinitely many solutions, we conclude that the system is *consistent dependent*.

As a result, only statement II is true.
